dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures feature thin, high-intensity perimeters with irregular, crenulated edges. A sharp gradient transition exists from the light-colored perimeter pixels to the darker interior cores, most notably in the mid-dorsal and mid-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters; most markings follow annular topologies. Sparse, localized concentrations of high-intensity pixels are visible in the anterior-lateral region near the flipper interface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular pentagonal spatial relationship, with the primary axis aligned longitudinally along the dorsal curve.
